content: We show the loss function analysis of transformer and our model. Figure FIGREF23 shows the validation performance of transformer against global training steps. Figure FIGREF21 show the validation performance of our model for the same number of global steps. Figure FIGREF22 shows that NMT loss is going down with the number of steps, while Figure FIGREF20 shows the degradation of the loss of our proposed RAT task.
